findings.description: Ordinary issue create/update cannot attach the reserved projection:autopilot-phase marker. IssueService.create and IssueService.update call _reject_reserved_projection_label which raises ProjectionIssueMutationError mapped to HTTP 403 in coordination_api.py. Database trigger enforce_projection_label_ownership (migration 039, lines 318-336) rejects any INSERT/UPDATE supplying the marker before work_queue_projection_ownership registration. Verified by live test test_database_rejects_unowned_spoofed_projection_issue and HTTP test test_ordinary_issue_api_cannot_cross_projection_boundary[create].
findings.resolution: Reserved marker is database-owned; ordinary issue APIs cannot create or update it. No defect remains.

findings.description: Ordinary issue update/close cannot mutate a registry-owned projection row. mutate_issue_if_unowned RPC (migration 039, lines 360-427) takes a row lock (FOR UPDATE), checks work_queue_projection_ownership before applying any allowlisted patch, and returns projection_issue_immutable which the HTTP layer maps to 403 (coordination_api.py:1445-1446, 1477-1478). Verified by live tests test_owned_same_generation_request_reactivates_terminal_canonical_issue and HTTP test test_ordinary_issue_api_cannot_cross_projection_boundary[update/close]. The row-locking RPC closes check/write races for all patched fields and batched closes.
findings.resolution: Registry-owned rows are immutable through ordinary issue APIs. HTTP 403 mapping verified. No defect remains.

findings.description: Migration 039 projection RPCs insert an unlabelled row, register its UUID in work_queue_projection_ownership, then apply the exact canonical label pair transactionally. submit_task and reconcile_work_projection insert with labels=ARRAY[]::TEXT[], then INSERT INTO work_queue_projection_ownership(task_id) VALUES(v_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, then UPDATE work_queue SET labels=p_projection_labels WHERE id=v_id (migration 039, lines 128-170, 251-314). The enforce_projection_label_ownership trigger rejects post-migration unowned inserts/label updates (lines 318-357). First-insert SSE works via notify_projection_insert trigger on the labelled UPDATE (lines 405-435). Replay, concurrent generation serialization, and explicit administrator adoption of pre-039 rows all verified by live tests test_same_generation_submit_replay_clears_noncanonical_owned_labels, test_owned_projection_cannot_take_over_unowned_issue_key, test_039_upgrade_fails_closed_until_owner_registers_verified_row.
findings.resolution: Transactional ownership registration with trigger enforcement verified. Upgrade path preserves fail-closed for pre-039 rows. No defect remains.

findings.description: Keyed submit and reconcile authorize publish_work_projection in the service layer with the exact change resource and mode/change audit context. WorkQueueService.submit and reconcile_projection call get_policy_engine().check_operation with operation="publish_work_projection", resource=key.change_id, and context={"mode": "submit|reconcile", "change_id": key.change_id} (work_queue.py:777-798, 922-933). HTTP layer coordination_api.py:1204-1268 does the same before delegating to the service. Direct MCP/service callers cannot fall back to ordinary submit_work because the service layer itself selects the elevated operation when projection_key is present. Verified by test test_standard_trust_cannot_publish_projection returning HTTP 403.
findings.resolution: Elevated operation authorization enforced at both HTTP and service layers. No defect remains.

findings.description: Cedar policy mode resolves omitted trust through the same shared fail-closed resolver as native policy. CedarPolicyEngine._do_check_operation calls resolve_trust_level and on TrustResolutionError returns a deny decision without reaching mutation (policy_engine.py:732-753). Native policy does the same (policy_engine.py:195-206). Both engines deny before any mutating RPC. Verified by test test_admin_resolves_trust_when_context_omits_it and trust-resolution fail-open test test_reconcile_propagates_instead_of_writing_unscanned.
findings.resolution: Cedar and native modes share fail-closed trust resolution. No defect remains.

findings.description: In-process converge() resolves the vendor panel using the reviewed worktree_path with explicit/local/coordinator/global precedence and retains SDK-only coordinator rosters. convergence_loop.py:610-616 calls _orchestrator_for_dispatch(None, worktree_path) when orchestrator and agents_yaml_path are omitted, matching the fixed CLI dispatcher resolution chain. Regression test test_converge_resolves_vendor_panel_from_reviewed_worktree fails if the stale coordinator-first constructor is used.
findings.resolution: Vendor resolution precedence corrected and regression-tested. No defect remains.

findings.description: Labelled and legacy unlabelled modes are isolated in both directions before head or row mutation. Unlabelled requests against any registry-owned row return projection_mode_mismatch before mutation (submit_task lines 97-112, reconcile_work_projection lines 225-240). Labelled requests against any complete unowned keyed row return projection_key_collision (submit_task lines 97-112, reconcile_work_projection lines 225-240). Verified by live tests test_unlabelled_projection_cannot_mutate_owned_labelled_namespace[submit/reconcile] and test_labelled_projection_cannot_enter_unlabelled_keyed_namespace[submit/reconcile]. Exact-key replay, newer-generation reconcile, pre-039 upgrade, ordinary legacy cancellation, and head preservation all validated.
findings.resolution: Mode isolation enforced at SQL boundary with structured error codes. No defect remains.

findings.description: Direct MCP and HTTP-proxy submit/reconcile accept and forward the exact projection_labels pair. MCP tools submit_work and reconcile_work_projection accept projection_labels parameter and pass it to service layer (coordination_mcp.py:398-423). HTTP proxy proxy_submit_work and proxy_reconcile_work_projection forward projection_labels in request body (http_proxy.py:473-525). Every projection conflict returns structured HTTP 409 via _ProjectionProblemError mapping (coordination_api.py:185-205) rather than a trigger exception. Verified by test test_proxy_submit_and_reconcile_projection_payloads and live PostgreSQL test suite.
findings.resolution: Label transport parity achieved across all entry points. Structured 409 conflicts verified. No defect remains.

findings.description: Pre-registry N-to-N+1 fail-close is enforced. Both labelled SQL paths acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock then scan for associated unowned projection:autopilot-phase rows by payload change_id or exact change:<id> label, returning projection_key_collision before head or row mutation (migration 039, lines 97-112, 225-240). Live test test_039_upgrade_fails_closed_until_owner_registers_verified_row proves migration-038 generation N blocks N+1 repair with head remaining (INIT,0) until explicit work_queue_projection_ownership registration.
findings.resolution: Preflight ordering and upgrade fail-closed verified in SQL and live migration test. No defect remains.

findings.description: Projection-head/ownership invariants hold. work_queue_projection_heads is updated atomically within the per-change advisory transaction. work_queue_projection_ownership is the sole ownership authority; mutable payload fields and labels cannot confer ownership. Active canonical rows preserve lifecycle state; owned terminal rows are reactivated to pending with lifecycle fields cleared and emit projection refresh event (migration 039, lines 156-175, 305-320). Verified by live tests test_owned_same_generation_replay_preserves_nonterminal_status, test_owned_same_generation_request_reactivates_terminal_canonical_issue, test_terminal_reactivation_refreshes_connected_sse.
findings.resolution: Head/ownership invariants transactionally enforced and tested. No defect remains.

findings.description: Canonical CLI persistence and ESCALATE resume work correctly. runner.py init, transition, escalate, apply-outcome, record-state-only-archetype, and project-state commands persist state before projection (design D8). enter_escalate increments total_iterations exactly once. Console-approved escalate_resume applies the canonical resolved edge before host projection. Resume reconciliation runs before gates/work. Verified by autopilot test suites: test_apply_outcome_contract.py (40 tests), test_runner_cli.py (15 tests), test_console_interviewer.py (10 tests).
findings.resolution: CLI protocol and ESCALATE resume fully tested. No defect remains.

findings.description: Connected-client visibility via SSE works for first-insert, reconciliation, and terminal reactivation. Migration 037 emits label-update events; migration 039 emits first-insert event via notify_projection_insert trigger. event_stream.py converts both to SSE snapshot replacement. Verified by live tests test_connected_sse_refreshes_after_atomic_projection_reconciliation, test_connected_sse_refreshes_for_first_canonical_projection_insert, test_terminal_reactivation_refreshes_connected_sse — all complete within 1 second.
findings.resolution: SSE visibility for all projection lifecycle events verified. No defect remains.

findings.description: Coordinator-free isolation is preserved. QueueProjectionAdapter is constructed only for coordinated hosts; runner.py project-state imports it lazily. Local-parallel and sequential tiers perform zero projection-module imports/construction and zero projection submit/reconcile/label-helper calls. Isolation test test_phase_projection_isolation.py fails closed if try_submit_work, try_reconcile_work_projection, or coordinator-only label helpers are imported or called from free tiers. Pre-existing coordinator detection/archetype resolution imports are retained per D10.
findings.resolution: Projection isolation scope verified by import/module and fail-fast call spies. No defect remains.
